description: Header file defining the AAH_TXSender class, CircularBuffer template, and related structures for RTP packet transmission in Android media framework.

classes.name: CircularBuffer
classes.description: Template class implementing a circular buffer for generic type T.

classes.name: AAH_TXSender
classes.description: Class responsible for sending RTP packets over network, managing endpoints, and handling retries.

classes.name: RetryReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread to handle retry requests asynchronously.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: Structure representing an IP address and port for network endpoints.

classes.name: RetryPacket
classes.description: Packed structure representing a retry packet with sequence range and endpoint info.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the circular buffer.

methods.name: pop_front
methods.description: Removes the front item from the circular buffer.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the buffer.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: itemAt
methods.description: Accesses item at a specific index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Array subscript operator for buffer access.

methods.name: handlerID
methods.description: Returns handler ID for message handling.

methods.name: doSendPacket_l
methods.description: Performs actual packet sending to endpoint.

methods.name: shouldSendHeartbeats_l
methods.description: Determines if heartbeats should be sent.
